name: Theodosian land walls (Marmara to Edirnekapi)
coord_quality: Published GPS at three gates; other vertices approximate
description: Main land-wall line built c.412-413 and rebuilt after 447. Vertices at the First, Silivrikapi and Fourth Military gates use published GPS values; the rest are approximate.

name: Blachernae sector walls
description: Northern extension to the Golden Horn, described as a later single-wall section and a weak link.

name: Marmara sea walls (schematic)
description: Single-line wall along the Sea of Marmara shore. Drawn as a schematic line following the shore; do not read as surveyed.

name: Golden Horn sea walls (schematic)
description: Single-line wall along the Golden Horn shore, described as weaker than the land walls. Schematic.

name: Golden Horn boom (schematic)
description: Chain across the mouth of the Golden Horn between Constantinople and Galata. Anchor points are debated.

name: Ottoman overland ship route (schematic)
description: Approximate traditional route by which about 70 ships were hauled from the Bosphorus into the Golden Horn on 22 April 1453. The exact path is debated.

name: Ottoman artillery focus (Lycus valley)
description: Sector of the land walls against which the heaviest guns and assaults are described as concentrated (Lycus valley / Mesoteichion).
